expected_output.restatement: Solo founder with $0 ad spend, a dialer, HubSpot, and a large cold list must land 5 paying AI-automation clients ASAP via outbound calls — tracked daily, without burning out.
expected_output.leading_question: Is 5 clients in 14 days, pure cold and solo, a target or a fantasy? [UNKNOWN until day 5 data]

positions.analysis: Pick one vertical and one repeatable pain before dialing; a niche call converts 3-5x a generic one. [INFERENCE]
No warm intros exist, so engineer authority: pattern-interrupt opener, small commitment ask, never a demo.
Invert: guarantee zero by dialing inconsistently, pitching instead of diagnosing, and burning out. Make each impossible.
Calls are convex bets — bounded 2-minute downside, unbounded upside. Burnout is ruin; cap intensity to what repeats 10 days.
The leverage point is the feedback loop between conversation quality and the script, not raw dial volume.
Loss = booked revenue. Find the daily bottleneck stage (connect, convo-to-meeting, proposal-to-close) and pour effort there.
Own the dials, not the yeses. Two protected blocks a day, hit regardless of mood; rest is part of the plan.

tensions.title: Volume vs. Targeting
tensions.b_text: Dialing the wrong 60 teaches nothing and demoralizes you.
tensions.resolution: Days 3-4 become a live A/B across two segments; the connect and conversation data picks the beachhead.

tensions.title: Speed vs. Burnout
tensions.a_text: Go maximal — a 6-hour marathon on day 1.
tensions.b_text: That guarantees quitting by day 6, and quitting is ruin.
tensions.resolution: Cap at ~3 hours of live talk-time per day in two blocks — repeatable for 10 straight days beats two heroic days.

stances.stance: Achievable in 14 days if deals are small enough for a fast yes.
Achievable if the bottleneck stage is fixed daily.
Achievable only from a chosen beachhead.
Realistic outcome is 2-4 closed plus pipeline.
Compounds only if the loop is instrumented.
Judge on inputs held with discipline, not the date.

verdict.recommendation: Plan and act for 5; forecast 2-4 closed by day 14 with pipeline behind them [INFERENCE]. Judge the sprint on leading inputs — dial-time and quality conversations — not the 5th check by an arbitrary date.

kill_criteria.condition: Quality-conversation rate under 8% in both niches means the list or offer is wrong — stop and fix targeting, not effort.
Zero proposals out means the choke is conversation-to-meeting — rework the ask, do not add volume.
Two consecutive dial blocks skipped from dread — cut to one block and protect the streak over the peak.

verdict.next_action: Build the 6-stage HubSpot pipeline with one-tap call dispositions and segment the cold list into two Active Lists.

expected_output.summary: Act for 5, forecast 2-4 by day 14 — judged on controllable inputs, kill criteria armed.
